[Version 0.1.0 Notes] 10/12/2026
Welcome to Zools (Zach Tools)! This is just a fun little program I developed in python that adds just small quality of life improvements to tools! Think of it as using mods on the tools. All suggestions are welcome!

Important Changes
- Rat list(s) has been updated with HopToDesk
- New extras script added to Grab computer's serial number

Fixes
- GUI now exists, can handle multiple drives, checkbox to apply mods, refresh button.
- Timestamp of last normal update and last mod update added

[Version 0.1.2 Notes] 10/14/2026
Welcome to Zools (Zach Tools)! I just want to CLARIFY and say that this program aims to add informational and/or quality of life ADDITIONS rather than fixes or modifications to how our scripts function. No part of these modifications intend to change our process, just some simple things that can speed up a specific workflow. If something is developed that goes against what was previously stated (something drastic like a Boot Configuration Fix), I would run it by the developer(s) of the original tools first AKA lead tech/managers.

Now that that's out of the way, here's the patch notes.

Important Changes
- Added the ability to remove zools from a toolkit. 

Other Stuff
 - GUI should update quicker when installing/uninstalling zools... because i coded it to refresh after you pressed the button. crazy how that works.
- Added these little blogs and navigation buttons at the bottom
- Added better error-handling when version number doesn't have an associated blog
- Fixed file hierachy and added .bat files for easy execution. Probably doesn't work with some python installations though. Tried adding a link to get downloads of git and python from ninite but it didn't work on my own laptop with python already installed so LOL idk it's case by case
0.1.4:
[Version 0.1.4 Notes] 10/19/2026
Greetings! Here's some quick patch notes for today.

Important Changes
- Updated RAT adding logic to we can pick and choose which RAT file to modify. Config has been adjusted so it only modifies RATs additions to the evaluation and not the service.
- Added a new script ZOOLS_Notes-Template-Insert. This adds a template into persistent notes to help recall important log-in information so we can work quicker and more efficiently. At this time, a backup of persistent notes is created in case anything goes wrong and can be restored at any time.

Fixes
- Made sure to read the correct file when looking for the timestamp of when Tools were last updated. Turns out I was reading the wrong file but still worked the same way. So basically I fixed a non-existent problem but it works better now so dw.
- Fixed issue where next/previous blog buttons did not update their current place after runtime initialization.

Other Stuff
-'Last Updated' is now color-coded just like the tools updater utility! Green is good, yellow is getting old, red should be updated. Works for both Tools and Zools.
- I tried to tone-down the whole 'Drive query took 0.000s' thing in the command line, should be less clutter. I also added a config constant for how long to time out, increased from 5 to 8 seconds
